findings.observation: The adult chibi remains unmistakably Ela Keshi: lightest-band skin, square compact face, wide-set eyes, low straight brow, broad flat nose, defined cupid bow, calm closed mouth, and one cheek mole all remain legible without a generic doll-face replacement.
The figure retains Ela’s short, ordinary lean-to-average construction: compact torso and shortened legs without added muscular definition, obesity, armor mass, or broad heroic shoulder inflation.
Both shortened arms preserve moderate upper-arm and forearm girth, narrow wrists, and compact adult hands; the closed ready-idle fists do not create gross body-width or limb-mass inflation.
The matte violet-plum-pink asymmetric crest, shaved side, front sweep, gathered mass, and multiple wrapped segments closely preserve the summon silhouette and construction.

The shaped teal short jacket retains its broad folded brown collar, divided hem, practical front closures, seam repairs and cuffs; generous brown repaired trousers, teal patch, and low boots preserve the source palette and construction, with no added accessory or tattoo.

Measured visual landmarks place the complete hair-and-head unit at approximately y=82–612 and the standing figure at approximately y=82–1454: about 38.6% of standing height, or roughly 2.59 heads tall. This exceeds the strict 36% ceiling and misses the requested 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one coherent adult chibi is present; the entire crest, head, both empty hands, both legs, and both boots remain fully visible inside safe parchment margins.
A grounded wide ready-idle stance, three-quarter torso, asymmetric arms, compact silhouette, and two empty fists read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

Only ordinary dyed hair, visibly mended cloth, practical closures, generous trousers, and worn low boots appear; there is no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, extra person, or supernatural effect.
